summary: Comprehensive frontend testing completed for Telugu-to-English Speaking Practice Coach app. Core functionality working correctly: question management, answer checking with contraction/article handling, mode switching, session flow, and data persistence. Minor issues found with package version warnings and deprecated props.

issues: props.pointerEvents is deprecated warning appears in console - should use style.pointerEvents instead

action_items: Fix deprecated props.pointerEvents usage - replace with style.pointerEvents throughout the app
Consider updating package versions to match Expo SDK recommendations (@react-native-async-storage/async-storage, expo-document-picker, expo-file-system, expo-speech)
Add visual feedback for PDF upload button (currently just shows upload UI, actual PDF parsing not testable without file)
Consider adding loading states for speech synthesis (currently silent if TTS fails)
critical_code_review_comments: File Size: index.tsx is 1445 lines - should be split into smaller components (Header, ScoreBar, ManagerPanel, ChatView, CallView, SummaryOverlay)
All core features working correctly: question add/delete/clear, answer checking with normalization, contraction expansion, article stripping, mode switching, session management, data persistence
Answer checking logic is solid with proper contraction handling (i'm → I am) and article stripping
localStorage persistence via AsyncStorage working correctly across all operations
Speech recognition and TTS properly implemented with error handling and keepalive pattern
All interactive elements have proper data-testid attributes for testing
seed_data_creation: No seed data needed - app uses localStorage for client-side persistence
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is fully functional. All core features tested and working: question management (add/delete/clear), answer checking with contraction/article normalization, mode switching (Chat/Call), session flow (disconnect/restart), data persistence across reload. Only minor code quality improvements needed (split large file, fix deprecated props warning, update package versions).
